paragraphs: Hyman cites Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 8:8, Moed Katan 1:5 and Sanhedrin 6:1 for Nikombi reciting before Rabbi Zeira.

notes.text: The catalog heading is נימקומבי, Nimkombi; the frozen body is ניקומבי, Nikombi. That name alignment remains open.

Hyman (vol. III, p. 946) prints ניקומבי, Nikombi, and קומי, “before.” The catalog heading is Nimkombi. In Guggenheimer’s Pesachim 8:8 and Moed Katan 1:5, Nikomachos says before Rabbi Zeira that there is no minimum amount for collecting bones. The same recitation appears in the consulted Sanhedrin 6:9:3, where Hyman’s notice cites 6:1. The Hebrew spelling there is Nikomakhei.
